subsection.title: User and Starting Context
subsection.description: Identify the confirmed Primary Persona and the concrete starting context for each core ideal use case.

subsection.title: Main Flow
subsection.description: - Include one block for each approved core ideal use case. - Start every block with an explicit Intent statement describing the product intent the use case demonstrates. - Describe three to eight sequential steps led by the Primary Persona's actions. - For each step, state the user action first, then the product response and expected result. - End every block with an observable completion result.
subsection.example:
**Core ideal use case: Shape a rough product idea**
**Intent:** Demonstrate that a product manager can turn an unstructured idea into a reviewable product direction through focused conversation.
| Step | Primary Persona action | Product response | Expected result | |------|------------------------|------------------|-----------------| | 1 | Jiyun starts a new idea with a short problem statement | Asks one focused question about the target user | Jiyun understands what information is needed | | 2 | Jiyun answers with the user's situation and desired change | Summarizes the proposed product direction | Jiyun can correct the interpretation | | 3 | Jiyun approves the summary | Shows the completed product overview | Jiyun has a reviewable starting point for the PoC |
**Completion result:** Jiyun can review and share the approved product overview.

subsection.title: Completion Result
subsection.description: Summarize what the Primary Persona can see, use, share, or decide after completing all approved core ideal use cases.

subsection.title: Key Interruptions
subsection.description: Optional. Describe at most two interruptions only when they materially change what a core ideal use case must demonstrate.
